title.zh: Coinbase Q3财报：营收约12.16亿美元同比降35%，调整后EBITDA约3.33亿美元
title.en: Coinbase Q3财报：营收约12.16亿美元同比降35%，调整后EBITDA约3.33亿美元

current_state.zh: Coinbase 2026年Q3财报显示净利润7.19亿美元，调整后EBITDA为3.329亿美元、环比增长60%，USDC平均余额达220亿美元创纪录，预测市场年化收入超2亿美元，Base代币化股票累计交易量超10亿美元，加密交易市场份额升至10.7%。
current_state.en: Coinbase's Q3 2026 earnings show $719M net income, $332.9M adjusted EBITDA up 60% QoQ, record $22B average USDC balances, over $200M prediction-market annualized revenue, over $1B cumulative tokenized-equity volume on Base, and crypto trading market share at 10.7%.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase Q3财报：营收约12.16亿美元同比降35%，调整后EBITDA约3.33亿美元
updates.title_en: Coinbase Q3财报：营收约12.16亿美元同比降35%，调整后EBITDA约3.33亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase公布第三季度营收约12.16亿美元，同比下降35%，净利润7.19亿美元受投资收益提振，调整后EBITDA为3.33亿美元，现货交易量大幅下滑而衍生品和预测市场增长。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase reported Q3 revenue of about $1.216 billion, down 35% year over year, with net income of $719 million boosted by investment gains and adjusted EBITDA of $333 million, as spot trading volumes fell sharply while derivatives and prediction markets grew.

updates.title_zh: 【Coinbase Q3 财报：三季度净利润为 7.19 亿美元，预测市场年化收入突破 2 亿美元】
updates.title_en: 【Coinbase Q3 财报：三季度净利润为 7.19 亿美元，预测市场年化收入突破 2 亿美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增披露调整后净利润7770万美元、USDC平均持有余额220亿美元、预测市场年化收入超2亿美元、Base代币化股票累计交易量超10亿美元、加密交易市场份额10.7%、订阅及服务收入占比49%等Q3运营指标。
updates.what_changed_en: Added Q3 operating metrics: adjusted net income of $77.7M, average USDC balances of $22B, prediction-market annualized revenue above $200M, over $1B cumulative tokenized-equity volume on Base, crypto trading market share of 10.7%, and subscription/services at 49% of net revenue.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase reported Q3 2026 net income of $719M with adjusted EBITDA up 60% QoQ, USDC balances hitting a record $22B, prediction-market annualized revenue exceeding $200M, over $1B in cumulative tokenized-equity volume on Base, and crypto trading market share climbing to 10.7%.
